thread:
Iris Park: quick heads-up — rx2b-int4 bring-up with reranker overlay + pair-append augment showed rerank-order diffs concentrated on augmented pairs.

Iris Park: run snippet:
```
run_id: rx2b-int4-176500
examples: 1,040
metric: rerank_precision_at_1
delta_p@1: -0.043
mismatch_cluster: pair-append (augmented pairs), ordering vs host
notes: 8 regen-id overlaps with golden; several failures show swapped top candidates after quant
```

Mateo Cruz: is this a rerank-model change or the augmentation creating near-duplicates that flip ties? can you paste 2 sanitized failing pairs?

Iris Park: it's pair-append v0.7 (appends a short reference then trims trailing separator). sanitized fails:
- "Query: best way to compress images || Appended: example with similar keywords" -> fp16 top: image-A, int4 top: image-B
- "Query: refund policy for subscription || Appended: near-duplicate QA" -> int4 drops vendor detail and ranks generic answer higher

Elena Voss: can you run a quick rolling-fingerprint de-dup vs main golden? if regen collisions exist we should remove those from the micro-golden. also include sample-stamps in outputs.

Iris Park: did that. collided 8 ids; I flagged them in the run metadata as `regen_collision:true`. full failing id list in the run artifacts.

qbench-bot: [qbench] drill: run=rx2b-int4-176500 baseline=rx2b-fp16-176400 delta_p@1=-4.3% ci=[-6.2%,-2.1%] top_signals=[order_flip,score_collapse,token_trim] link=https://qbench.local/runs/rx2b-int4-176500

Mateo Cruz: proposed triage plan:
1) rerun canary with `--disable-pair-append` to isolate augmentation,
2) rerun int4 with `--kernelset=legacy-2026-02` + `--kvcache-trace=on` for 6 failing seeds,
3) build micro-golden (200 examples) of rerank edgecases (include both augmented and original variants) and re-evaluate p@1.

Elena Voss: I'll own (3). I'll dedupe micro-golden against main golden using token-fingerprint + regen mapping, exclude the 8 collisions, and tag each sample with `sample-stamp` (<run>-<seed>-<ts>). ETA ~5h. I'll also include the host fp16 vs int4 top-k snippets for manual inspection.

Mateo Cruz: I'll do (2). I'll collect KV dumps for the 6 seeds, include first-256 tokens, and upload to s3://redwood/qbench/kvdumps/rx2b-176500/. If kernel fallback removes the delta we need a runtime guard for trimmed-append cases.

Iris Park: I'll kick off (1) now and post updated qbench link. muting pair-append from baseline for that run.

infra-bot: [task] ticket INF-1777 created: "rx2b-int4: rerank order flips with pair-append augment" assigned to curation+runtime.

Mateo Cruz: small follow-up: add `sample-stamp` to failing ids in the run output and include first-128 tokens of the prompt for each failing seed. also include regen-id mapping csv.

Elena Voss: will do. also plan to run a fast semantic-similarity check (embed cos sim) to flag near-duplicates that might bias ranking.

Iris Park: thanks — will upload diffs and artifact links to INF-1777 once available. marking bring-up P1 until we resolve ordering instability. :thumbsup:
